scope: One new stdlib-only synthetic AST regression executes only the option-summary loop and frontier aggregation statements extracted from analyze_study. It does not import the runner or project, invoke analyze_study/load_lineage, or read/write historical evidence.
captured_regression_assertions: Every authored option row retains its fit timing, identity, configuration and selected status when calibration is null.
Missing target gain, protected harm and behavioral pass remain null with calibration_available false.
Frontier available counts and conditional means use calibrated options only; missing count is all assigned minus available and all-null means are null.
Behavioral pass fraction retains the all-assigned denominator, including an assigned lineage with no record; missing calibration contributes no success.
Fully calibrated configuration arithmetic and selected counts remain preserved.

original_capture_boundary.scope: The earlier fit_case_arm capture remains evidence for its own original runner/regression/configuration snapshot. The final runner and engineering configuration differ. This new capture covers the extracted summary statements only and does not recapture fit_case_arm, full analysis, actual JSON persistence or native behavior.

limitations: Synthetic fit timings and calibration metrics are fixture constants, not measured research observations or lifecycle savings.
The regression directly compiles only the reviewed AST statements against stdlib fakes; it establishes no complete analysis or lineage-loading compatibility and performs no model forwards.
The source identity list is scoped and is not a complete dependency/environment fingerprint or OS/network sandbox. SHA-256 identifies records without independent attestation.
Private capture records and workstation paths remain private. Public command labels are sanitized; exact argv is identified by the private launch-record hash.
Costs unavailable during fitting and historical failed-call usage/charges remain unknown; successful serialization and missing-data summaries do not recover them.
Original study margins, all-assigned denominators, criteria wording/status and unknown costs remain unchanged; issue #14 remains partial and open.
Hosted CI, packaging/publication checks and subsequent documentation are separate from this execution.
